column3: The Hebrew says God blessed him; BSB repeats Obed-edom’s name.
The Hebrew calls the family their father’s house and describes the sons as mighty men of valor; BSB uses families and strong, capable men.
The Hebrew twice calls Shimri the head; BSB twice uses the first.
The Hebrew describes small and great according to their fathers’ house; BSB uses young and old and families.
The Hebrew uses active plural agents casting lots; BSB makes this passive. It names east and north without separately repeating gate.
The Hebrew ends with watch opposite watch; BSB describes guards stationed at every watch.
The Hebrew calls the groups sons of the Korahites and sons of Merari; BSB uses descendants.
The Hebrew names Ahijah over the treasuries; BSB instead describes their fellow Levites as being in charge.
The Hebrew calls Shebuel Gershom’s son; BSB uses descendant.
The Hebrew calls the relatives his brothers; BSB uses relatives.
The Hebrew describes responsibility through Shelomith’s hand; BSB uses under his care.
The Hebrew calls Hashabiah’s relatives his brothers; BSB uses relatives.
